title: Thai Herring Tagine
description: A unique and flavorful Thai-inspired dish featuring herring in a tagine-style stew. Serve with steamed rice or noodles.

ingredients.name: herring
ingredients.notes: Fresh or canned, drained and rinsed

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade Thai spice blend

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: For balance of sweetness and spice

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger, and sauté until softened.
Add herring fillets and cook until browned on both sides.
Add tagine spice mix, fish sauce, brown sugar, and lemon juice.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles and garnish with fresh herbs if desired.
